title: Spectral Rank Certification for Foundation Model Adapters
abstract: arXiv:2608.15351v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Nominal LoRA rank is a design parameter; calibrated spectral evidence is a separate inferential quantity. This article develops a finite-sample framework for inferring effective rank structure in public foundation-model adapters. The theoretical core is an exact chi-square divergence for the fixed-dimensional Gaussian rank-one reference experiment, with an unknown signal direction integrated under a rotation-invariant reference prior. The resulting series yields a computable finite-sample Le Cam bound at concrete layer sizes, an explicit remainder bound for numerical truncation, and the rectangular Baik-Ben Arous-Peche (BBP) limit. A compact-manifold Laplace expansion shows that finite-sample likelihood evidence also depends on leading spectral gaps through the factor $s_1^{|m-n|}\prod_{i\ge2}(s_1^2-s_i^2)$, motivating joint calibration of clustered singular values. Building on these results, we introduce an empirical-null workflow for P

translated_title: 基础模型适配器的谱秩认证
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15351v1 公告类型：新 摘要：名义LoRA秩是一个设计参数；校准的谱证据是一个独立的推断量。本文开发了一个有限样本框架，用于推断公共基础模型适配器中的有效秩结构。理论核心是固定维高斯秩一参考实验的精确卡方散度，其中未知信号方向在旋转不变参考先验下积分。得到的级数在具体层大小下产生可计算的有限样本Le Cam界、数值截断的显式余项界以及矩形Baik-Ben Arous-Peche（BBP）极限。紧流形拉普拉斯展开表明，有限样本似然证据也通过因子$s_1^{|m-n|}\prod_{i\ge2}(s_1^2-s_i^2)$依赖于前导谱间隙，从而激励聚类奇异值的联合校准。基于这些结果，我们为P引入了一个经验零工作流。
tldr: 本文提出了一种有限样本谱秩认证框架，用于基础模型适配器，通过精确卡方散度和BBP极限，实现有效秩结构的可靠推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a finite-sample spectral rank certification framework for foundation model adapters, enabling reliable inference of effective rank structure via exact chi-square divergence and BBP limit.
